summary: Minimal, correct fix that clamps the computed CPU count to at least 1 via max(1, ...), directly preventing the avail_cpu==0 crash in multiprocessing.Pool for both the cfs_quota and cpu.shares paths. No regression or compatibility concerns; matches the issue's suggested resolution.

issues.description: No comment explaining why the lower bound of 1 is enforced (i.e., to avoid the 0-CPU crash); a brief note would aid future readers, but the change is self-evident enough to merge without it.
